Design and implement a DevOps-Enabled Qualification Verification System Using Git and CI/CD Practices 
 
Background 
Educational institutions, professional bodies, and employers increasingly require reliable mechanisms to verify academic and professional qualifications. Software engineers must develop systems that are secure, scalable, maintainable and supported by modern DevOps practices.

4.	Develop automated tests to verify software requirements. 
5.	Produce evidence-based evaluations of software quality and team collaboration. 
6.	Critically justify architectural and technological decisions.
